title: It emits way too much heat
text: It emits way too much heat. It moves around fine with its wheels as far as energy efficiency it’s hard to tell since it blows so much hot air and I have to turn it off and overcompensate with a little window AC unit the noise is all right. I wish I would’ve returned it within the window it completely heated up my entire room. Too bad I don’t know what I’m gonna do now

product_metadata.title: Kesnos 60 Pints Dehumidifier, 4500 Sq. Ft Large Dehumidifier for Home and Basement with 6.56ft Drain Hose and 0.92 Gallon Large Water Tank, 24Hr Timer and Auto Defrost Ideal for Large Sized Rooms, Bedrooms, Laundry Rooms
features: DEHUMIDIFIER FOR SPACES UP TO 4,500 SQ FT - Our dehumidifier removes up to 60 pints (under 95°F, 90%RH condition) of moisture per day (Please note: The max dehumidification capacity is up to 60 pints under 95°F, 90%RH working condition) for spaces up to 4,500 Sq. Ft. Being able to adjust humidity from 30%RH to 80%RH, it is a perfect dehumidifier for basements, homes, offices, bathrooms, bedrooms, kitchens, stockrooms, living rooms, laundry rooms, and crawlspaces.

UNIQUE DESIGN FOR MODERN HOMES - This Kesnos portable dehumidifier is designed with a sleek and modern look. The castor wheels and ergonomically recessed handles allow you to move this dehumidifier easily. A quiet fan won't disturb you when you sleep or work, and it has two speeds for you to adjust. With the dry clothes function, you simply place the dehumidifier in a room where you can hang the wet clothes and let it dry clothes naturally.

EASY OPERATION - The home dehumidifier will run and will automatically shut off when it reaches your preset humidity level. Two drainage options: Auto Drain: With the included 6.56ft/2m drain hose, you can drain the collected water continuously without emptying the water bucket. Manual Drain: The bucket full indicator let you know when the water bucket (0.92 Gallon) needs to be emptied. Auto defrost function: It can detect the frost and defrost automatically.

INTELLIGENT CONTROL - Auto Humidity Control: Simply set the ideal humidity level, it will smartly sense the room humidity and maintain your preset humidity. 24hr Timer: Allow you to preset the time to turn on or off the machine. Auto Shut-Off/ Restart: Shuts off automatically when the water bucket is full, and restarts after the bucket has been emptied. Power Outage Restart - The machine will restart when power resumes.

EXCELLENT CUSTOMER SUPPORT - The Kesnos PD220B Home Dehumidifier is covered with a 30-day money-back, 1-year warranty, 2nd-year extended warranty and lifetime expert support. Please don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions, and we will reply to you within 24 hours.
